subject.title: fix(codex): backoff startup connection-close retries and surface exhaustion (#83959) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this Codex startup fix land as a bounded 5-attempt backoff now, or should the author replace it with an explicit replacement-server readiness gate before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but it deliberately trades faster persistent failure for better recovery from transient replacement-server warm-up races in a P1 startup path.

options.title: Accept Bounded Backoff
options.body: Merge after maintainer review if the added persistent-failure latency is acceptable for recovering the reported transient startup-close race.

options.title: Require Readiness Gate
options.body: Ask for a revision that admits retries only after a concrete replacement-server readiness signal rather than time-based backoff.

options.title: Sequence With Startup Timeout Work
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide how it should compose with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442.
